Welcome to NextGen PMM

We're live on SAP BTP infrastructure — aligned with Brenda, Sean, and the Global AI Champions Council. This is your resource for the AI era.

October 28, 2026

We're Back — And We've Leveled Up

NextGen PMM is now running on SAP BTP infrastructure, aligned with enterprise standards and ready to scale. This isn't just a technology upgrade — it's a signal that what we've been building together has earned its place in the SAP ecosystem.

Over the past year, our pilot cohort proved the model: AI as co-worker, mapped to the Book of Work, validated by practitioners. The numbers speak for themselves — 181 PMMs enrolled, 73% quiz pass rate, 9.1 NPS. More importantly, 60%+ of you are already applying what you learned at work.

Now we're taking everything we learned and scaling it — with sponsorship from Brenda Brown, alignment with Sean Thomson and the LoB PMM teams, and direct connection to the Global Marketing AI Champions Council.

This site is your resource. Your front door to PMM excellence in the AI era.

📘 What's New

New branding. We're now NextGen PMM — a cleaner identity that reflects where we're headed.

New infrastructure. SAP BTP means enterprise-grade reliability and integration with the broader SAP ecosystem.

New leadership structure. The PMM AI Champions Council connects our work to every Line of Business.

We've published the full strategic roadmap — how this site, our people, and our AI-enabled workflows will transform Product Marketing at SAP. If you want to understand where we're going and why, start here.

The core idea: Common standards and AI cut the effort of repeatable work, so PMM capacity shifts to strategy, insight, and growth. We call this the 10x PMM.

Know → Learn → Do

Your career journey through NextGen PMM follows three connected paths:

1

Know the Work

The Book of Work defines what great PMM execution looks like — methods, standards, and best practices for every responsibility.

2

Learn the Skills

Role-based learning journeys build your capabilities — from foundations to advanced AI-augmented techniques.

3

Do the Work with AI

Approved tools, agents, prompts, and guided workflows — embedded in the flow of your everyday work.

This isn't sequential — it's continuous. Know the standard, build the skill, apply it with AI. Repeat.
